signaling_summary: Main Link: 1/2/4 AC-coupled differential pairs carrying NRZ at RBR 1.62 / HBR 2.7 / HBR2 5.4 / HBR3 8.1 Gbps/lane with ANSI 8b/10b coding (DC-balanced, transition-rich, LFSR-scrambled) so the panel Sink can recover the embedded clock; the ASSR alternate scrambler seed is used when enabled. eDP also defines a reduced-swing electrical option for panel power saving. Each lane carries per-lane voltage-swing (4 levels) and pre-emphasis (4 levels). AUX: one AC-coupled bidirectional half-duplex differential pair, Manchester-II coded at ~1 Mbps.
clocking: Embedded clock on the Main Link — recovered by the panel Sink's CDR during Clock Recovery (no dedicated Main Link clock lane). The Mvid/Nvid pair in the MSA lets the panel regenerate the pixel clock from the recovered link clock; during PSR the panel runs its own timing.

transmitter_specs_canonical.scrambling: LFSR (reset by the SR symbol; ASSR alternate seed when enabled)

receiver_specs_canonical.clock_recovery: Panel Sink CDR recovers the embedded clock per lane during the CR training phase.
receiver_specs_canonical.equalization: Channel Equalization (EQ) phase trains the receiver to CHANNEL_EQ_DONE + SYMBOL_LOCKED + INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE.
receiver_specs_canonical.status_reporting: Reports CR_DONE / CHANNEL_EQ_DONE / SYMBOL_LOCKED / INTERLANE_ALIGN_DONE and ADJUST_REQUEST in DPCD.
receiver_specs_canonical.fast_link_training: FLT applies stored drive settings for the fixed embedded channel without iterative adjustment.

8b10b.note: 10-bit DC-balanced symbol per 8-bit char; control (K) symbols frame the stream; ASSR alternate seed when enabled.

downspread: Spread-spectrum clocking (down-spread) is supported (MAX_DOWNSPREAD / DOWNSPREAD_CTRL in DPCD) to reduce EMI.
encoding_role_in_analog: 8b/10b provides DC balance and transition density so the panel Sink CDR can recover the embedded Main Link clock without a forwarded clock lane; scrambling (with the ASSR alternate seed when enabled) spreads the spectrum and provides basic content protection. AUX uses Manchester-II so the low-rate management channel is self-clocked.

backlight_electrical.control: panel backlight set over AUX (eDP backlight DPCD) or a dedicated backlight PWM pin
backlight_electrical.pwm_generator: EDP_PWMGEN_BIT_COUNT / EDP_BACKLIGHT_FREQ_SET configure the panel PWM frequency / resolution
